description: Egypt’s 2025 Labour Law: at least 2 months’ wage per year for an unjustified dismissal, plus 3 months’ notice pay. See what your employer and NOSI owe you. Web page: https://calcbright.com/egypt-end-of-service-calculator

end.description: End date Leave empty to use today's date. (YYYY-MM-DD)

insured.description: Monthly insurable wage (optional) The wage your social insurance is paid on. Leave empty to use your wage within the 2026 limits (EGP 2,700–16,700).

notice.description: Notice given by the employer (months) Months of written notice you received (the law requires 3 months).
